// inMergeMerge is the input of Merge.Merge.

	E types.E
}

type inMergeG struct {
	X int
}

// inMergeD is the input of Merge.D.

	Value int
}

	Xs []int

==== /merge_vandorf.go
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.

package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"example.com/app/types"
)

type envMerge struct {
	inMergeMerge inMergeMerge
	outMergeMerge types.MergeArgs
	inMergeD inMergeD
	outMergeD int
	inMergeG inMergeG
	outMergeG int
}

const (
	pcMerge_MergeMerge = iota
	pcMerge_MergeD
	pcMerge_MergeG
)

// RunMerge runs proc Merge.
func RunMerge(ctx context.Context, e types.E) (int, error) {
	var zero int
	env := &envMerge{}
	env.inMergeMerge = inMergeMerge{E: e}
	pc := pcMerge_MergeMerge
	for {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return zero, err
		}
		switch pc {
		case pcMerge_MergeMerge:
			this := types.MergeArgs{E: env.inMergeMerge.E}
			zeroOut(&env.inMergeMerge)
			_ = this
			if this.E.Tag == "A" {
				b_x := this.E.A
				_ = b_x
				env.inMergeD = inMergeD{Value: b_x}
				pc = pcMerge_MergeD
				continue
			}
			if this.E.Tag == "B" {
				b_x := this.E.B
				_ = b_x
				env.inMergeD = inMergeD{Value: (b_x + 1)}
				pc = pcMerge_MergeD
				continue
			}
			return zero, fmt.Errorf("Merge.Merge: no match arm for %v", this)
		case pcMerge_MergeD:
			this := env.inMergeD.Value
			zeroOut(&env.inMergeD)
			_ = this
			env.inMergeG = inMergeG{X: this}
			pc = pcMerge_MergeG
			continue
		case pcMerge_MergeG:
			this, err := unimplementedMergeG(ctx, env.inMergeG.X)
			if err != nil {
				return zero, fmt.Errorf("Merge.G: %w", err)
			}
			zeroOut(&env.inMergeG)
			_ = this
			return this, nil
		default:
			return zero, fmt.Errorf("Merge: invalid state %d", pc)
		}
	}
}


==== /runtime_vandorf.go
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.

package app

import (
	"cmp"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"slices"
	"sync"
	"unsafe"
)

// mapGet looks up k, failing if it's missing.
func mapGet[K comparable, V any](m map[K]V, k K) (V, error) {
	v, ok := m[k]
	if !ok {
		return v, fmt.Errorf("key %v not found", k)
	}
	return v, nil
}

// sliceGet indexes xs, failing if i is out of range.
func sliceGet[E any](xs []E, i int) (E, error) {
	if i < 0 || i >= len(xs) {
		var zero E
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("index %d out of range [0, %d)", i, len(xs))
	}
	return xs[i], nil
}

func mapHas[K comparable, V any](m map[K]V, k K) bool {
	_, ok := m[k]
	return ok
}

// mapKeys returns m's keys in order.
func mapKeys[K cmp.Ordered, V any](m map[K]V) []K {
	ks := make([]K, 0, len(m))
	for k := range m {
		ks = append(ks, k)
	}
	slices.Sort(ks)
	return ks
}

// mapValues returns m's values in key order.
func mapValues[K cmp.Ordered, V any](m map[K]V) []V {
	vs := make([]V, 0, len(m))
	for _, k := range mapKeys(m) {
		vs = append(vs, m[k])
	}
	return vs
}

// mapMerge returns a new map with a's entries and b's, b winning. Maps
// are values in vandorf, so the arguments are never changed.
func mapMerge[K comparable, V any](a, b map[K]V) map[K]V {
	r := make(map[K]V, len(a)+len(b))
	for k, v := range a {
		r[k] = v
	}
	for k, v := range b {
		r[k] = v
	}
	return r
}

// Arrays that sliceConcat builds keep spare capacity in reserve. The
// reserve is hidden from every slice handed out, whose capacity is clipped
// to its length, so code that appends to one (implementations included)
// always copies. reserves records each such array by the address of its
// first element: how much of it is filled. A + whose left side ends
// exactly there appends into the reserve; any other copies. So values
// never change where anyone can see, and a loop like acc + [x] costs
// amortized O(1) per element. A finalizer drops an array's entry when it's
// freed, before its address can be reused.
type reserve struct{ filled, cap int }

var (
	reservesMu sync.Mutex
	reserves   = map[uintptr]reserve{}
)

// sliceConcat returns a new slice with a's elements, then b's; neither
// changes.
func sliceConcat[E any](a, b []E) []E {
	n := len(a) + len(b)
	var zero E
	size := int(unsafe.Sizeof(zero))
	if size == 0 {
		// All zero-size arrays share one address: nothing to reserve.
		return make([]E, n)
	}
	if p := unsafe.SliceData(a); p != nil {
		base := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p))
		reservesMu.Lock()
		if r, ok := reserves[base]; ok && r.filled == len(a) && n <= r.cap {
			reserves[base] = reserve{n, r.cap}
			reservesMu.Unlock()
			full := unsafe.Slice(p, r.cap)
			copy(full[len(a):n], b)
			return full[:n:n]
		}
		reservesMu.Unlock()
	}
	// Room to double, and over 16 bytes: the tiny allocator's blocks may
	// never be finalized.
	c := max(2*n, 16/size+1)
	r := make([]E, n, c)
	copy(r, a)
	copy(r[len(a):], b)
	p := unsafe.SliceData(r)
	base := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p))
	reservesMu.Lock()
	reserves[base] = reserve{n, c}
	reservesMu.Unlock()
	runtime.SetFinalizer(p, func(*E) {
		reservesMu.Lock()
		delete(reserves, base)
		reservesMu.Unlock()
	})
	return r[:n:n]
}

// mapRemove returns a new map without the keys ks.
func mapRemove[K comparable, V any](m map[K]V, ks []K) map[K]V {
	r := make(map[K]V, len(m))
	for k, v := range m {
		r[k] = v
	}
	for _, k := range ks {
		delete(r, k)
	}
	return r
}

// ptrTo boxes a value, for fields that would otherwise make a type contain
// itself.
func ptrTo[T any](v T) *T {
	return &v
}

// zeroOut clears a slot no later state reads, so the garbage collector can
// reclaim what it held.
func zeroOut[T any](p *T) {
	var zero T
	*p = zero
}

// joinAll runs fs concurrently and waits for all of them: a spawn's joined
// branches. The first error cancels the rest and is returned.
func joinAll(ctx context.Context, fs ...func(context.Context) error) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer cancel()
	var (
		wg    sync.WaitGroup
		once  sync.Once
		first error
	)
	for _, f := range fs {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			if err := f(ctx); err != nil {
				once.Do(func() { first = err; cancel() })
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	return first
}

// spawnDetached runs f on a goroutine of its own, a spawn's detached branch:
// nothing waits for it, it outlives ctx's cancellation, and a failure is
// only reported.
func spawnDetached(ctx context.Context, f func(context.Context) error) {
	ctx = context.WithoutCancel(ctx)
	go func() {
		if err := f(ctx); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: %v\n", err)
		}
	}()
}

// fanOut runs f over xs concurrently and returns the results in input order.
// The first error cancels the remaining elements.
func fanOut[E, R any](ctx context.Context, xs []E, f func(context.Context, E) (R, error)) ([]R, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer cancel()
	out := make([]R, len(xs))
	var (
		wg    sync.WaitGroup
		once  sync.Once
		first error
	)
	for i, x := range xs {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			r, err := f(ctx, x)
			if err != nil {
				once.Do(func() { first = err; cancel() })
				return
			}
			out[i] = r
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	return out, first
}

// unimplementedMergeG stands in for Merge.G, which names no .go implementation. Write
//	func Name(ctx context.Context, x int) (int, error)
// and add `= "file.go:Name"` to its declaration.
func unimplementedMergeG(ctx context.Context, _ int) (int, error) {
	var zero int
	return zero, errors.New("Merge.G is not implemented")

==== /sum_vandorf.go
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.

package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"example.com/app/types"
)

type envSum struct {
	inSumSum inSumSum
	outSumSum types.SumArgs
	inSumL inSumL
	outSumL types.SumLOut
	inSumId1 inSumId1
	outSumId1 int
}

const (
	pcSum_SumSum = iota
	pcSum_SumL
	pcSum_SumId1
)

// RunSum runs proc Sum.
func RunSum(ctx context.Context, xs []int) (int, error) {
	var zero int
	env := &envSum{}
	env.inSumSum = inSumSum{Xs: xs}
	pc := pcSum_SumSum
	for {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return zero, err
		}
		switch pc {
		case pcSum_SumSum:
			this := types.SumArgs{Xs: env.inSumSum.Xs}
			zeroOut(&env.inSumSum)
			env.outSumSum = this
			env.inSumL = inSumL{Value: types.SumLOut{I: 0, Acc: 0}}
			pc = pcSum_SumL
			continue
		case pcSum_SumL:
			this := env.inSumL.Value
			zeroOut(&env.inSumL)
			env.outSumL = this
			{
				if (env.outSumL.I == len(env.outSumSum.Xs)) {
					env.inSumId1 = inSumId1{Value: env.outSumL.Acc}
					zeroOut(&env.outSumL)
					pc = pcSum_SumId1
					continue
				}
			}
			v1, err := sliceGet(env.outSumSum.Xs, env.outSumL.I)
			if err != nil {
				return zero, fmt.Errorf("Sum: %w", err)
			}
			env.inSumL = inSumL{Value: types.SumLOut{I: (env.outSumL.I + 1), Acc: (env.outSumL.Acc + v1)}}
			zeroOut(&env.outSumL)
			pc = pcSum_SumL
			continue
		case pcSum_SumId1:
			this := env.inSumId1.Value
			zeroOut(&env.inSumId1)
			_ = this
			return this, nil
		default:
			return zero, fmt.Errorf("Sum: invalid state %d", pc)
		}
	}
}

package types

// E is a typedef.
// Tag is one of "A", "B"; the field it names holds the payload.
type E struct {
	Tag string
	A int
	B int
}

// MergeArgs is the type of the parameters of Merge.
type MergeArgs struct {
	E E
}

// SumArgs is the type of the parameters of Sum.
type SumArgs struct {
	Xs []int
}

// SumLOut is the type of the return of Sum.L.
type SumLOut struct {
	I int
	Acc int
}

func mapRemove[K comparable, V any](m map[K]V, ks []K) map[K]V {

// joinAll runs fs concurrently and waits for all of them: a spawn's joined
// branches. The first error cancels the rest and is returned.
func joinAll(ctx context.Context, fs ...func(context.Context) error) error {

		wg    sync.WaitGroup
		once  sync.Once

// The first error cancels the remaining elements.
func fanOut[E, R any](ctx context.Context, xs []E, f func(context.Context, E) (R, error)) ([]R, error) {

	defer cancel()

		wg    sync.WaitGroup
		once  sync.Once

				once.Do(func() { first = err; cancel() })
				return

		}()

	wg.Wait()
	return out, first

			env.inSumL = inSumL{Value: SumLOut{I: (env.outSumL.I + 1), Acc: (env.outSumL.Acc + v1)}}
			zeroOut(&env.outSumL)
			pc = pcSum_SumL
			continue
		case pcSum_SumId1:
			this := env.inSumId1.Value
			zeroOut(&env.inSumId1)
			_ = this
			return this, nil
		default:
			return zero, fmt.Errorf("Sum: invalid state %d", pc)
		}
	}
}
